The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: very happy and eager.

draft.emotion: bouncing with nervous energy, heart beating fast from anticipation
notes: Used both to describe how a person feels (excited, nervous) and how a situation feels (thrilling, exciting).
Do not confuse with สนุก (sanuk), which means fun or enjoyable without the nervous or high-energy edge of being tūen-tên.

senses.definition: Feeling nervous and happy because something good or important is about to happen.

examples.text: พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะไปเที่ยวทะเล ฉันรู้สึกตื่นเต้นมาก
examples.translation: Tomorrow I'm going on a trip to the sea, I feel very excited.
examples.emotion: grinning broadly, unable to sit still because tomorrow is the big trip

senses.definition: Causing strong feelings of excitement or suspense.

examples.text: หนังเรื่องนี้สนุกและตื่นเต้นมาก
examples.translation: This movie is fun and very exciting.
examples.emotion: eyes wide with adrenaline, remembering the best parts of the action scene
